relatedPosts.title: Creating a browser-based recording tool with flask + recorder.js + p5.js on TypeScript
relatedPosts.description: Create a simple recorder using recorder.js, a wrapper for the Web Audio API. Implement the UI by writing p5.js, the browser version of Processing, in TypeScript.

relatedPosts.title: Building a Text Classifier with SVM using Doc2Vec and Optuna
relatedPosts.description: As a practice for using Optuna, I quickly wrote a text classifier using Doc2Vec. The output includes the model's accuracy, F1 score, and a Confusion Matrix using `pyplot`.

relatedPosts.title: Turning Nintendo Switch Joy-Con into a Musical Instrument via Python
relatedPosts.description: I participated in the development of `joycon-python`, a Python library that retrieves information from a Bluetooth-connected Joy-Con via hid. Using `joycon-python`, I created a script called `joycon-osc` to send signals via OSC (Open Sound Control), and then received the transmitted information in Max to generate sound.
